comments.body: Apparently it's a book sold in Japan with the release of Tierra Americana expansion. Since in the West it's a completely free to play (fueled by microtransactions) and there's no subscription model, this item is unavailable.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Due to KOEI being... KOEI, any recipe books with the note 'unavailable' will likely go unreleased on Maris server indefinitely. It is nevertheless possible to send a support ticket to PapayaPlay and request that they receive permission from KOEI to have individual equipment items be released via cove/UWC shop -- that is currently the best one can hope for.
